stance_rationale: alpha_scores.parquet is a single 2026-04-30 snapshot, not a walk-forward Date×Ticker×score time series, so the package fails the mandatory Iter 4/RF-A7 alpha schedule check. The reported evidence is also weakened by rank_IC and monotonicity failures, full-sample factor/regime/weight selection, and incomplete multi-testing controls.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet has 348 rows, columns Ticker/sig_date/alpha/..., and only one sig_date. The required multi-sig-date alpha schedule is absent; weights.csv schedule and covariance.parquet were also not present at the requested paths.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Package formula text states 'Z_Score_Aligned of -1 * std' and 'Z_Score_Aligned of -1 * Ohlson_O_score'. Code appears to load Z_Score_Aligned, but the package itself documents manual sign inversion language.
factor_db_connector.R align_factor_direction uses Usable_Date <= sig_date when sig_date is supplied.
Alpha factor loads in v2/v3 use load_month_factors(...), with value.var='Z_Score_Aligned'.
Regime rows are shifted to ym_for_apply and merged into the next signal month; package current_state fields are lagged.
Factor specs and request declare quarterly 45d plus annual May lag; factor sourcing is through the Factor DB connector.

critical_concerns.description: RF-A7 hard failure: alpha_scores.parquet is one snapshot at 2026-04-30, not Date×Ticker×score across >=60 monthly sig_dates; this can reproduce the Iter 4 static-alpha bug and invalidates walk-forward use. Cites: RF-A7, AX-002, PIT-C1.

Core predictive gate is not clean: rank_IC=0.0372 fails the 0.04 KR threshold and monotonicity_decile_avg=0.0303 is far below the 0.80 checklist threshold. ICIR/NW-t cannot silently override failed directional ordering. Cites: AX-002, L-121.

RF-A6 is unresolved: factor set, regime definition, and ICIR weights were selected on the same 2008-2026 sample used for validation; DSR uses M=7 despite 3 regime definitions and model choices, harvey_t_specs_pass_count=2, and no CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 5-spec report exists. Cites: RF-A6, AX-002, PIT-C1.

AX-001 defense mechanism is fragile: original Quality thesis is partially invalidated, Q07 and Q25 have bad/normal ratios near 0.84, composite bad/normal ratio is only 1.2779 below the stated >1.5 target, and Core MDD relief is delegated to Risk rather than evidenced. Cites: AX-001, AX-005, L-121.

PIT-C13 package-language conflict: code uses Z_Score_Aligned, but the submitted factor_specs include '-1 *' formulas for Q07 and Q25. The package must prove registry-only direction alignment and remove manual flip semantics. Cites: PIT-C13, AX-002.

No Silent Override evidence is incomplete: challenge_note.md, factor_engine_proposal.R, artifact_lineage.json, qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260502_001, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet were absent, so AX-008 triangulation and requested schedule/PSD checks cannot pass. Cites: AX-008, AX-002.

RF-A4 cannot be verified: the package only states sector+size neutralization is embedded in Factor DB, with no pre/post sector-neutral ICIR comparison. This is material for Quality/Tail factors with possible sector concentration and L-219-style family saturation risk. Cites: RF-A4, L-219, AX-004.

RF-A5 historical liquidity check is incomplete because the submitted alpha schedule is only one date. Independent current-snapshot top-decile ADV20 passes 2e8 KRW, but the package records a 5e7 KRW threshold and cannot prove historical top-decile liquidity. Cites: RF-A5, AX-002.

supporting_arguments: Composite ICIR=0.399 exceeds the best retained single-factor ICIR shown in the package, so RF-A2 is not triggered on submitted numbers.
Subperiod stability=1.0, NW-t=5.7071, and primary DSR=0.6708 pass their stated thresholds, subject to the RF-A6 in-sample and trial-count objections.
Current-snapshot top alpha decile independently passes the 2e8 KRW ADV20 liquidity floor; the issue is missing historical schedule validation.
C14/C15/C9 are mostly supported by code-level evidence through load_month_factors and lagged regime merge logic.
unresolved_disputes: No alpha_package.json, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, or *_challenge_note files were present for the requested 3-agent context.
Stage artifact dir A qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260502_001 does not exist; only stage_artifacts/WT_D20260502_001 exists.
weights.csv was absent, so schedule validation could not be performed.
covariance.parquet was absent, so PSD and condition number <=100 post-shrink could not be checked.
No artifact_lineage.json exists for this WT, so write_json -> record_lineage order is not auditable.
Academic references have paper names but no page-level citations, and KR applicability is mostly ex-post IC rather than a separate mechanism test.
weakest_assumption: The package assumes that a full-sample-selected regime/factor/ICIR-weighted composite plus one current alpha snapshot is sufficient evidence for a deployable KR defense alpha, despite no nested walk-forward alpha schedule.
rebuttal_required: Produce alpha_scores.parquet as multi-sig-date Date×Ticker×score with at least 60 monthly sig_dates and no future dates.
Recompute factor selection, regime definition, and composite weights in rolling or expanding walk-forward form, then report out-of-sample IC diagnostics.
Run the required 5-spec CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 tests and DSR with a trial count covering factors, regimes, weighting methods, coverage thresholds, and gating choices.
Explain or fix failed rank_IC and monotonicity without relying on ICIR/NW-t as a silent override.
Remove '-1 *' formula wording or provide code-level proof that only registry-driven Z_Score_Aligned is used.
Add challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json, then restore requested weights/covariance artifacts or mark them explicitly infeasible.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Claude's package has useful exploratory diagnostics, but Codex cannot approve because the mandatory time-series alpha artifact, multi-testing controls, and lineage/context artifacts are missing or incomplete.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the factor/regime/weighting choices maintain t_NW > 2.95 under nested walk-forward, not full-sample selection?
Can the alpha vector be regenerated as a PIT-safe monthly history with fundamental Usable_Date <= sig_date and no manual sign flips?
If AX-001/AX-005 defense status depends on D43 tail skew rather than Q07/Q25 Quality, is the submitted hypothesis being revised or merely relabeled?
